objectives:
1. Solve systems of linear equations using Gaussian elimination, row echelon form, and reduced row echelon form.
2. Perform matrix operations, including matrix multiplication, finding inverses, and using elementary matrices.
3. Explain the relationship between row operations and matrix multiplication through elementary matrices.
4. Apply Gaussian elimination beyond solving linear systems, including computing matrix inverses and LU decomposition.
5. Define vector spaces axiomatically and verify whether a given set with operations forms a vector space.
6. Identify subspaces of vector spaces.
7. Use linear combinations and span to describe sets of vectors and subspaces.
8. Determine whether a set of vectors is linearly independent or linearly dependent.
9. Find bases and compute dimensions of finite-dimensional vector spaces.
10. Identify linear transformations between vector spaces.
11. Construct matrix representations of linear transformations with respect to standard or chosen bases.
12. Compute and interpret the null space and range of a linear transformation.
13. Apply the Rank–Nullity Theorem to relate the dimensions of the domain, null space, and range of a linear transformation.
14. Compute column spaces and row spaces of matrices and explain their relationship to linear transformations.
15. Understand and compute orthogonal complements with respect to the dot product.
16. Compute determinants and use them to determine invertibility.
17. Find eigenvalues and eigenvectors of matrices and interpret their algebraic and geometric meanings.
18. Determine whether a matrix is diagonalizable and, when possible, diagonalize it.
19. Connect major concepts of linear algebra, including systems of equations, matrices, vector spaces, linear transformations, determinants, and eigenvalues.
20. Write mathematical proofs
content:
Week 1 Introduce to Linear Algebra
Week 2 Gaussian Elimination and Row Echelon form
Week 3 Elementary Matrix and Matrix Multiplication
Week 4 Application of Gaussian Elimination beside Solving Linear Equations: Find Inverse and UL Decomposition of Matrix
Week 5 The First Midterm and Vector Spaces
Week 6 Axiomatic system of Vector Spaces
Week 7 Subspaces, Linear Combination, and Linear Independence
Week 8 Basis and Dimension of the Vector Space
Week 9 Linear Transformation
Week 10 The Second Midterm and Matrix Representative of Linear Transformation
Week 11 Range and Null Spaces of the Linear Transformation
Week 12 Rank-Nullity Theorem, Column Spaces and Row Spaces, Althogonal Complement
Week 13 Determinant and Invertibility
Week 14 Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
Week 15 Diagonalization
Week 16 Final
